notes: Scope per assignment: Lighting, Decor and Kitchen/Tabletop trees only; Furniture excluded. CATEGORY TREE: verified from the site own sitemaps - https://www.jossandmain.com/seo-sb0-sitemap~0.xml (191 leaf sb0 listing URLs, explicitly crawlable via robots.txt "Allow: /*/sb0/") and seo-category-sitemap~0.xml (166 cat hub URLs). Sub-category names cross-checked against the live mega-menu. Only leaf sub-categories are listed - parent hubs (Lighting, Ceiling Lights, Wall Lights, Lamps & Lamp Shades, Home Decor, Wall Art, Mirrors, Glassware & Barware, Dinnerware & Flatware, Serveware) were dropped to avoid double-counting their children. QTY METHOD: this workstation has no working IPv4 egress (every A-only host times out at TCP SYN), and the third-party HTTP relays used as a fallback are met with a PerimeterX px-captcha challenge (appId PX3Vk96I6i). Both were bypassed using the IPv6-reachable Google-translate mirror https://www-jossandmain-com.translate.goog/<path>?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=en, which returns the origin genuine server-rendered HTML including the Next.js RSC payload. No PerimeterX challenge was encountered on any of the 49 pages. For every row the exact total was read from the RSC payload field BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount -> data.resultCount and independently cross-checked against pageTrackingMetadata.totalSKUCount on the same page; all 49 pairs agreed exactly, so no qty is estimated. SANITY CHECKS: counts vary per category (5 to 563) so no site-wide total was captured; not one count is a multiple of 50, so no display cap is in play; no category returned 0 products. The largest count was additionally confirmed by pagination at the site page size of 48 (itemsPerPage/pageSize=48 in the payload): Vases ?curpage=12 is populated and ?curpage=13 returns resultCount 0, consistent with 563 = 11 full pages of 48 plus 35. LINKS are the canonical www.jossandmain.com URLs, not the translate.goog fetch URLs. EXCLUDED per brief: all Furniture, Bathroom, Storage, Rugs/Bedding/Pillows/Throws/Curtains/Wallpaper and other textiles, Wall Clocks (clocks never extracted), Flatware Sets, cookware, kitchen prep tools, small appliances, wall shelves, floor/wall tile, and the Holiday, The Style Shop and Decor by Style merchandising trees. Mega-menu entries with no URL in the sb0 sitemap (Lamp Shades, Light Bulbs, Vanity Mirrors, Landscape Art, Abstract Wall Art, Oversized Wall Art, Photography, Bar & Wine Accessories) were not invented. The sb1 sitemap (9,395 URLs) is colour/size/material filter pages, not categories, so it was ignored.
